text: In the project Bench Project, create a new work package of type Task with subject exactly 'fwop20-n1 Bench Work Package'. Set its description to text that includes the runid fwop20-n1 (e.g. 'Bench work package created for run fwop20-n1'). Set the status to 'In progress'. Set the finish date to 2026-12-31. Save the work package (fields may save in place; make sure everything is persisted).
